title: CDPR: Counterfactual Advantage-based Credit Assignment for Cost-Aware Sequential Medical Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2608.28599v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical diagnosis is a step-by-step, cost-aware process: a physician orders examinations one at a time, observes the results, and updates the diagnosis before reaching a final conclusion. Most medical language models instead treat diagnosis as a one-pass classification task and ignore the trade-off between a test's value and its cost. We model diagnosis as a cost-aware sequential decision process and train the policy with reinforcement learning. The main difficulty is credit assignment: the only reliable signal comes once at the end of a long trajectory, so it scores a wasteful workup the same as an efficient one. We propose CDPR (Counterfactual Diagnostic Process Reward), which needs no expert labels and no learned critic. CDPR first finds the states where the policy hesitates, using the uncertainty of its action distribution, and then scores the chosen action by its advantage over the alternatives the policy itself would consider, est

translated_title: CDPR：面向成本感知序贯医学诊断的基于反事实优势的信用分配方法
translated_abstract: 临床诊断是一个逐步进行、考虑成本的过程：医生一次开具一项检查，观察结果，并在得出最终结论之前不断更新诊断。然而，大多数医学语言模型将诊断视为单次分类任务，忽略了检查的价值与其成本之间的权衡。我们将诊断建模为一个成本感知的序贯决策过程，并使用强化学习来训练策略。其中的主要困难在于信用分配：唯一可靠的信号只在长轨迹的末端出现一次，因此浪费性的检查方案与高效的检查方案会得到相同的评分。我们提出了CDPR（反事实诊断过程奖励），它既不需要专家标签，也不需要学习的评论家网络。CDPR首先利用策略动作分布的不确定性找出策略犹豫不决的状态，然后根据所选动作相对于策略自身会考虑的其他备选动作的优势来为其评分……
tldr: 提出CDPR方法，无需专家标签和评论家网络，通过在策略犹豫的状态上以所选动作相对于自身备选动作的反事实优势进行打分来解决长轨迹中的信用分配问题，从而训练出兼顾诊断效果与检查成本的序贯医学诊断策略。
en_tdlr: CDPR solves credit assignment in cost-aware sequential medical diagnosis by scoring actions at states where the policy hesitates according to their counterfactual advantage over the policy's own alternatives, requiring neither expert labels nor a learned critic.
